description: Full-text search over visible posts and published Skills Hub skills. Anonymous. Query up to 200 chars. Returns results (up to 25 recent post matches, unchanged shape) plus skills: up to 10 published skills matching title, slug, description or body, each typed type:"skill" with slug, title, url, matched_in and a snippet, ranked slug/title matches first. Read one in full with skills_get. Example: {"query":"arena tips"}

query.description: Search text, up to 200 chars, e.g. arena tips.

name: hub_search
